blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Jordan Murphy sent high school teammate George King home. The hard part is just about to begin as he faces a tougher import matchup in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup semifinals. Barangay Ginebra survived San Miguel Beer, 110-94, in Game 5 of their race-to-three affair in the quarterfinals to arrange a showdown against TNT, which it had faced four times in the Finals over the last two years. When that faceoff begins, Murphy will go toe-to-toe with the Tropang 5G’s Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, whose performance in his team’s quarterfinal sweep of Masangfolas validated his stature as a three-time Best Import awardee […]...
